ai_method: The review includes an AI-powered acne chatbot intervention alongside non-AI telemedicine, communication and tracking interventions.
study_summary: Among fourteen mixed digital-intervention studies, the Results describes a thirty-person AI-chatbot acne intervention with improved reported quality-of-life measures.
limitations: The fourteen studies are not all AI trials, and the chatbot component cannot be credited with the effects of the entire mixed intervention.

ai_method: The review evaluates personalization stages, current multimodal machine-learning prognosis and AI-enabled adaptive support in depression iCBT.
study_summary: Clinical severity and support needs have stronger practical evidence than predictive biomarker matching; ML prognostic gains have not established improved outcomes from prescriptive treatment selection.
limitations: Current AI-related evidence is part of a broader psychotherapy review. Prognostic prediction and improvements caused by AI-guided treatment adaptation are distinct claims.

ai_method: A published machine-learning actigraphy pipeline derives sleep probabilities, validated against polysomnography in a subset of monitored surgical patients.
study_summary: Thirteen patients contribute multimodal circadian recordings; six have the actigraphy-versus-PSG comparison, with reported AUROC 0.81.
limitations: The 1.8 million data points are repeated sensor observations, not patients; the small post-hoc ML validation does not establish improved postoperative outcomes.

ai_method: OCTAL combines digital cognitive tasks with machine-learning feature ranking, LASSO and random-forest diagnostic classifiers.
study_summary: Four validation studies cover 1,664 participants; the 194-person memory-clinic cohort supports discrimination of Alzheimer-type dementia from subjective cognitive decline.
limitations: The five-minute and twenty-minute batteries and cross-validated or out-of-bag model evaluations are separate comparisons; diagnostic discrimination does not establish benefit from replacing clinical assessment.

ai_method: The dental-simulation review includes an evaluated GPT virtual-patient application for diagnostic reasoning, alongside conventional virtual simulation and future AI proposals.
study_summary: Fifty-seven studies map simulation tools and training outcomes; a current LLM-based virtual patient provides an AI-specific component.
limitations: The fifty-seven studies are not all AI interventions, and improved learner performance does not establish improved patient dental outcomes.

ai_method: PASTEC provides purpose-built prospective annotation, pseudonymization and data infrastructure for medical-AI evaluation rather than a newly trained diagnostic model.
study_summary: Routine remote-monitoring use includes 1,276 recordings, 697 with structured annotation; added annotation time is measured during platform feasibility evaluation.
limitations: Prospective data aggregation and platform usability do not constitute prospective validation of a fixed predictive AI system.

ai_method: A similarity-based machine-learning framework models individualized multivariate wearable physiology to derive an inflammatory-change index.
study_summary: Sixty-one volunteers receive eighty vaccine doses; the wearable index correlates with serum inflammation and systemic reactogenicity.
limitations: Doses are repeated exposures rather than independent participants; moderate biomarker correlation does not establish interchangeable diagnostic testing.
